otherWork.title: Sora
desc: SORA is a women's personal safety companion paired with Apple Watch, offering mode-based protection, safe-word detection, and trusted-circle check-ins for the 1 in 3 women worldwide who don't feel safe in their own community. SORA does not surveil — it accompanies.

otherWork.title: PawPath
desc: PawPath is an automated post-adoption monitoring platform that replaces manual shelter follow-up with scheduled adopter check-ins and a real-time staff dashboard. It surfaces flagged cases, declining wellbeing scores, and overdue check-ins early — so shelters can intervene before an animal is returned.

otherWork.title: Afterwards
desc: Afterwards is a two-sided platform for what follows a death: one side lets someone organize documents, assign trusted people to tasks, and leave personal messages while still alive — the other guides the person they chose through it all, urgent matters first, at a pace calibrated for grief. It reframes end-of-life planning as anticipatory care, turning a frantic hunt for hidden documents into a final, considered act of love.

otherWork.title: YANA (You Are Not Alone)
desc: Mental health challenges affect 1 in 10 people worldwide, often in isolation. YANA makes support visible by building a safe digital community that connects users with both compassionate peers and certified mental health professionals.

otherWork.title: Bookworm
desc: Readers spend significant time immersed in books, but lack dedicated spaces to connect over shared literary tastes. Bookworm is a community platform that transforms solo reading into a shared social experience, enabling users to exchange reviews, discuss insights, and connect with fellow readers.

otherWork.title: Chinese Zodiac
desc: Vector illustrations of the 12 Chinese zodiac animals designed for mobile emoji use.

about.heading: Welcome to my space👋
paragraphs: I'm Yichun (ee-CHUN), a Product Designer with 7+ years of experience. My path started in finance, and that background still shapes how I design today — I care as much about the business case behind a feature as I do about the interface itself. Since making the switch, I've worked across consumer products and B2B SaaS with teams at BCG, Sallie Mae, and Best Egg.

I'm currently a Senior UX Designer at J.P. Morgan Private Bank, where I lead lending solutions and mentor other designers on the team. I also use AI tools to prototype faster and turn research into clearer decisions.

testimonials.quote: Yichun consistently delivers outstanding work, seamlessly translating stakeholder requirements into exceptional user experiences. Her proficiency with our design system enables her to identify opportunities for innovative solutions, and her contributions are consistently impressive. We are truly fortunate to have her as part of our team.
testimonials.name: Kevin Kruger
testimonials.title: Director of Product Design at Best Egg

testimonials.quote: She is a high-performing designer and has been doing a fantastic job gathering the requirements/asks and turning them into great designs. She has had to juggle through Marlette's transitions of the design board and taking requests from multiple areas/people. Her work and her attitude are exceptional.
